title: Golden Section mistake entry
description: MISTAKES.md is Markdown, not JSON — this schema documents and validates the shape of one entry for any tool that parses the file. scripts/build.mjs enforces the same rules directly against the Markdown. The canonical form of one entry is: ### 16 · Running out of cash `Executive` Self-explanatory... don't do it. **Prevented by** · [Cash Flow Forecast](plays/executive/saas-cash-flow-forecast.md) The heading, the anchor, the category line, and the detail are hand-authored. The **Prevented by** line is generated from the plays' preventsMistakes frontmatter and is overwritten on every build. Entries appear in ascending numeric order. Numbers are permanent: they are cited from goldensection.com, from LookingGlass, and from every fork. Never renumber an entry and never reuse a retired number.

number.description: The mistake's permanent number. A new mistake takes the next unused integer.

anchor.description: Stable link target, the number zero-padded to three digits. Must agree with `number`.

title.description: The mistake stated as a behaviour, not as a category of risk. Short and blunt.

categories.description: One or more functional areas the mistake belongs to. Rendered as an inline-code line beneath the heading, joined by ' · '.

detail.description: One to three sentences: what happens, and why it costs something. Optional — one of the 161 has none.

preventedBy.description: GENERATED. Slugs of the plays that prevent this mistake, derived from each play's preventsMistakes list. Never authored by hand; edits here are discarded on the next build.

stories.description: Optional longer write-ups in stories/, named mNNN-short-slug.md. Must be anonymised.
